title: Layered Espresso Tonic with Orange
summary: Chilled tonic water is poured over ice, a double espresso is floated slowly on top to make a dark layer, and an orange peel twist adds fragrance.

ingredients.item: freshly brewed espresso (a double shot) or strong moka-pot coffee

steps.title: Fill the glass
steps.text: Fill a tall glass with ice and pour in the cold tonic.

steps.title: Brew
steps.text: Pull a double espresso into a small jug.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Pour the espresso very slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats; it will foam up.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.text: Twist the orange peel over the glass and drop it in.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drink right away, stirred or layered.

tips: Very cold tonic keeps more fizz and makes a cleaner layer.
Pour slowly: hot coffee hitting tonic foams vigorously.
Cold brew concentrate works instead of espresso.
storage: Make to order; it goes flat within minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
